title: Imaginary Portraits
author: Walter Pater
description: "Imaginary Portraits" by Walter Pater is a collection of character sketches written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The work explores the lives and artistic sensibilities of various historical figures and imaginary personalities, delving into their psychological and aesthetic complexities.

authorInfo.bio: Walter Pater (1839–1894) wrote Imaginary Portraits. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
